description: On the bed in front are a purple dustpan, a red plastic fork, a small yellow block beside a short wooden piece, a beige wooden block, and a larger yellow bottle-shaped toy. The left hand reaches forward toward the small yellow block, pinches it up, lifts it slightly, then moves left to place it into the purple dustpan and releases it, while the right hand stays open and mostly still near the lower right without touching anything.
